question: Which pillar earns follows: Forgotten Knowledge or The Human Mind?
why: Follows per post exist only for feed posts and stories; carousels are the one place the pillar-to-follow link can be measured.

question: Does a tension hook do better when it pays off into kindness or discovery than into a coping tip?
why: Tone audit: conflict hooks win reach but the only follows came from a reframe. Tests the fix directly. 18:00 reels stay on X5 until 23 Nov.

question: Which closing question gets more real replies: a choice (Which one?) or a personal one (Tried it?)
why: Every post must end on a 1-3 word question; this finds which kind. Judge only substantive comments once the comment queue runs.

question: Does a named series label on the cover lift saves?
why: Series give viewers a reason to follow; saves are the closest reel-level signal.
